newsitem.title: USA: Garden Botanika says Aug. sales disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Garden Botanika says Aug. sales disappoint.

text.p: Garden Botanika Inc said its same store sales for the first three weeks of August have disappointed the company and could have an impact on third quarter earnings if the trend continues.
The August same store sales were only "somewhat better" than July, which increased one percent over one year ago.

"We had expected that comparable store performance would improve due to much easier comparisons with last year," it said in a statement. Earlier, Garden Botanika reported fiscal second quarter earnings and said quarterly same store sales rose a mere two percent from the previous year.
In its second quarter ended Aug. 3, Garden Botanika reported a net loss of $0.31 a share on revenue of $16.9 million versus a loss of $0.23 a share on $10.1 million in sales last year.
Its shares were off 2-5/8 to 10-5/8 in active trading.
"The apparent trade off of sales between existing aand new product lines was disappointing," Michael Luce, president, said of the company's sales.
Garden Botanika markets botanically based cosmetic and personal care products in 196 retail stors across the U.S. and through catalog sales.
